orion-logistics.description: End-to-end logistics management platform: native Android app (Kotlin/MVVM/Hilt), NestJS backend on a self-hosted VPS with MySQL, route optimization with OSRM, and a Next.js web dashboard.
orion-logistics.longDescription:
Are your drivers running routes by feel, losing time, with no way to know what was actually delivered? OrionLogistics solves that.

An Android app every driver carries in their pocket that:
• Organizes and optimizes routes automatically
• Records every delivery with photos, signatures and notes as irrefutable evidence
• Captures all customer activity: who, what, when, where
• Prints billing tickets on the street with portable printers
• Turns the whole operation into clear metrics from day one

The system syncs orders automatically, manages roles (Admin, Driver, Merchandiser) and keeps a complete record of who did what and when — no paper, no excuses.

Real results in active operations:
📦 40% less time on routes
✅ 25% fewer operational errors
🚀 +50 deliveries per day
